interpretationPrinciple: Preserve the section's editorial hierarchy and responsive behavior at the narrowest proved scope. Do not generalize its white field, yellow carousel state, typography, card shadow, or motion into site-wide tokens.

visualIntent.summary: A clean editorial news stage: generous white space establishes clarity, large media carries recognition, compact black actions create decisive rhythm, and the carousel changes density rather than merely shrinking between desktop and mobile.
hierarchy: Section identity is established by a large italic heading.
A secondary archive link remains visible but subordinate.
News assets dominate each card before headline and action.
Pagination and edge controls communicate that more stories exist without competing with story content.
The following red section is intentionally exposed as a hard boundary; WHAT'S NEW is not an isolated rounded panel.
brandSignals: italic, heavy display typography for the section heading
black rectangular CTAs with italic bold labels
black edge carousel controls with a localized yellow current/available emphasis

layers.rule: Full-viewport-width white field with no rounded outer shell, inset card background, or framing border.
Heading and archive link share one row on desktop; they stack and center on mobile.
Two equal cards per desktop page; one full-width card per mobile page.
Strict reading order: uncropped image, centered headline, centered CTA.
Edge previous/next controls flank centered pagination; the active page must correspond to visibly changed news content.
End the white field cleanly and allow the next section's contrasting red field to begin directly below.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: Full viewport width; observed padding 60px 0; source section height 748.59px in captured state.
responsiveMatrix.mobile390: Full viewport width; observed padding 32px 0 60px; source section height 628.09px in captured state.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: White field is edge-to-edge and has no outer card shell.
Heavy italic display role identifies this section.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: PT Sans 18px/28.8px, 800 italic, aligned to the right of the heading row.
responsiveMatrix.mobile390: Same observed type role, centered on a separate line below the heading.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: Secondary to the heading but visible before story content.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: Two 576px equal cards with 24px gutter; six stories form three pages.
responsiveMatrix.mobile390: One 390px full-width card; six stories form six pages.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: The mobile layout reflows to one story rather than scaling the two-card desktop composition.
Preserve the independent asset's 578:325 ratio without crop.

responsiveMatrix.mobile390: PT Sans 20px/26px, 800, centered within an observed 325px content width.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: Headline follows image and precedes CTA.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: Black rectangular action, 56px observed height; 20px bold italic label.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: High-contrast black action remains centered below the headline.

responsiveMatrix.desktop1440: Pair-based navigation with centered three-page pagination.
responsiveMatrix.mobile390: Single-story navigation with six dots and 60x60 black edge controls; disabled previous is 0.5 opacity.
responsiveMatrix.invariant: Pagination count maps to pages at the current breakpoint, and controls sit outside the story reading order.

interactionRecipes.outgoing: Translate horizontally toward the navigation direction while fading to opacity 0.
interactionRecipes.incoming: Begin slightly below scale 1 while fading in and settle at center, scale 1, opacity 1.
acceptance: Image, headline, and CTA identity visibly change after navigation.
The transition includes a visible intermediate state; changing only index, class, or pagination is a failure.
Desktop advances two stories; mobile advances one story.
Settled incoming content is opacity 1 and outgoing content is opacity 0.

interactionRecipes.rule: On hover, the label visibly changes from white to black as part of an inversion treatment.
interactionRecipes.unresolved: The exact color and shape of the animated background layer were not captured; do not invent them.

interactionRecipes.observed: Settled nodes expose vp-slide/vp-pop behavior, a 0.5s transform transition, a 0.4s opacity transition, title delay 0.6s, and CTA delay 0.8s.
interactionRecipes.restriction: Do not prescribe a start transform, exact trajectory, overshoot amount, or scroll timeline until a clean from-offscreen recording exists.

mustPreserve: image -> centered headline -> centered CTA reading order
two cards desktop and one card mobile
allowedVariation: story copy and image identity may change per source item
headline may wrap naturally according to original English content and available width
desktop groups the same six stories into pairs while mobile presents them individually
mustNotReplace: Do not use a screenshot crop as runtime card media.
Do not crop or cover-fill the 578:325 story image.
Do not retain two columns at 390px.
Do not add rounded outer section or card-shell styling unsupported by evidence.

sectionLocalRules: PT Sans headline and action typography
notGlobalTokens: White is not inferred as the global site background.
Black CTA styling is not inferred for every button.
Yellow is not inferred as a global primary, active, or core-action color.
Kanit italic is not inferred for all headings.
The news card shadow is not inferred for all cards.
The carousel transition is not inferred for Hero, product, or navigation carousels.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Exact line breaks and card-height consequences for original English headlines cannot be prescribed.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Use semantic source copy and responsive width; do not hard-code line breaks from the translated captures.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Entry-on-scroll may not be implemented as an exact source recreation.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Keep as a candidate or omit; carousel motion remains independently approved.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Only the text-color inversion is approved.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Do not invent a yellow, white, or shaped hover layer.

unresolvedClaims.impact: Source-specific focus appearance cannot be claimed.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Provide an accessible focus state, but label it implementation accessibility rather than source fidelity.

conditions: Design direction must preserve section-local scope.
Original English wrapping must be verified independently or left fluid.
Entry-on-scroll motion cannot be an exact-fidelity claim.
Carousel QA must capture before, transition, and settled states at desktop and mobile.
